snippet.title: Milwaukee Is Giving Away Tools… And Dropping New Ones
snippet.description:
Milwaukee Tool is launching a national grant campaign in partnership with Bring Back the Trades to support students entering the workforce. Starting in April 2026, the program will award monthly grants consisting of toolkits valued at at least $1,500. These grants are available to public schools and registered nonprofit organizations in the United States. The program aims to provide professional-grade equipment for curriculum tracks like plumbing, electrical, automotive, and carpentry. Organizations can reapply every six months and are eligible to win once every three years. You can find more information and apply at bringbackthetrades.org.In addition to the grants, Milwaukee is expanding its AIR-TIP vacuum accessory line with several new products launching next month. A highlight is the bucket topper dust collector, which attaches to a five-gallon bucket to suck up dust while you mix materials. Other new releases include a compact dust collector that sticks to the wall using suction , an automotive detail brush, a boiler coil cleaning brush, and various scraper blades.
